args.sql:
WITH container_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry AS container_id,
        (sd.tempstabidx * (1 - rm.compscore) * (1 - sd.tempdevcount)) AS efficiency_score,
        sd.tempstabidx AS temperature_stability,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sd.tempstabidx * (1 - rm.compscore) * (1 - sd.tempdevcount)) DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        container c
    JOIN 
        sensordata sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
    JOIN 
        regulatoryandmaintenance rm ON c.containregistry = rm.shipgov
)
SELECT 
    container_id, 
    efficiency_score, 
    temperature_stability, 
    rank
FROM 
    container_efficiency
ORDER BY 
    rank
LIMIT 5;

WITH container_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry AS container_id,
        (sd.tempstabidx * c.coolremainpct * (1 - rm.compscore)) AS efficiency_score,
        sd.tempstabidx AS temperature_stability,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sd.tempstabidx * c.coolremainpct * (1 - rm.compscore)) DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        container c
    JOIN 
        sensordata sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
    JOIN 
        regulatoryandmaintenance rm ON c.containregistry = rm.shipgov
)
SELECT 
    container_id, 
    efficiency_score, 
    temperature_stability, 
    rank
FROM 
    container_efficiency
ORDER BY 
    rank
LIMIT 5;
